blocks.x: What Data & Lakehouse changes for Hospitals & Provider Networks: the processes we target, the controls we inherit, the platforms underneath, and the measured delta at every gate.

Providers run 24/7 operations on clinical goodwill: clinician burden, throughput, revenue-cycle leakage and patient experience all compete for the same attention. Systems that industrialize documentation, coding and workflow intelligence give clinicians their time back — the only resource that matters.

items: Outcome and throughput analytics depend on extracts; cohorts take days to define.
Notes, orders and inbox consume evening hours; ambient tools stall on EHR integration and compliance sign-off.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: EHR, imaging, genomics and claims on FHIR-native governed foundations with terminology services (cohort queries in minutes with lineage). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 are measurement only: we lock the current metric with your team and both sides sign it before a line of build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a named control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 turn what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, then report the measured delta against the baseline. A missed gate means a documented stop-or-redirect decision, not a quiet extension.
